insight.headline: $388K (27%) of July's $1.44M overrun is renewal timing, not overspend
insight.detail: Joining the SAP posting date on IT cost center 4270 with the Ariba contract calendar shows the Salesforce renewal posted in July this year versus August last year — pure timing. SAP alone shows an overrun and Ariba alone shows a renewal on schedule; only the join proves the structural miss is ~$1.05M of cloud, not $1.44M.
insight.action: Reclass the framing in the QBR pre-read and confirm the Q4 AWS run-rate with James Whitfield at 10:30.

insight.headline: This week's approvals commit $128,400 — 86% of Daniel's $150K delegation limit
insight.detail: Stacking the Ariba PO ($42,000) against the Adobe renewal sitting in DocuSign ($86,400) shows one week of approvals nearly exhausting the delegation threshold, with SAP showing Deloitte already at $186K YTD. No single queue shows the cumulative exposure — Ariba, DocuSign and SAP each see only their own slice.
